posts.title: Spotify Free July

posts.title: Site to Site VPN with Wireguard
posts.description: I recently moved and because of which my networking requirements got more complicated. We went from a multigenerational home into two single family homes. With this I now needed to not only manage two networks, but also share services between the two networks as well. Now the point of this post, which is I wrote a script that got a site to site wireguard vpn up and running between the two houses.
